summary: Goldman Sachs posted Q1 record equities trading revenue, topping expectations. Bank of America held first investor day in ~15 years, targeting cross-sell growth between consumer/wealth divisions. Wells Fargo growing all businesses except home lending after regulatory cap loosened. Analysts expect record trading fees at all major banks in 2026. JPM is seen outpacing rivals. All majors have meaningful private credit exposure.
